provenance.denominator: All retained OTU counts per fecal sample, including OTUs without a genus assignment.
provenance.duplicatePolicy: Exclude every count record with a duplicated fecal visit token; do not pool or choose replicates.
provenance.analysis: Median per participant across Healthy visits; unadjusted rank tests on count-derived relative abundances; not CLR or DREAM.
provenance.thresholdNote: 1000 retained reads is a transparent exploratory QC choice, not a threshold reproduced from the source paper.
